name: bridge-walker
description: Bridge Walker: balance a soldier across a rope bridge on your LG webOS TV, steering with your phone's tilt. A parent & kid project.

scripts.webos:package: npm run webos:build && ares-package dist-webos -o build-webos
scripts.webos:install: npm run webos:package && ares-install -d tv build-webos/com.realitybridge.game_0.1.0_all.ipk && ares-launch -d tv com.realitybridge.game
